verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is First NDC (Updated submission), filed 2021-07-29. 67 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (21). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 93.3 MtCO₂e, DS-35 64.2 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 59.8 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: Reduce per capita greenhouse gas emissions to 7.7 tCO2e by 2030, equivalent to a 26% reduction compared to 2005 of 10.4 tCO2e per capita; interim target of 8.8 tCO2e per capita by 2025 It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.35°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.82°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
